text:
Photos of alleged patent images for the upcoming all-electric 
Volvo XC90
 have surfaced on the European car enthusiast forum,
 
Worldscoop
. The patent images were leaked not long after Volvo’s trademark filing of the name EXC90, and although the final name for the EV successor of the XC90 has yet to be confirmed, we’ll stick to calling it the Volvo EXC90 for now.
As seen in the leaked patent images, styling cues at the front of the Volvo EXC90 have been taken from the XC40-based Polestar 2. Some have pointed out the possibility of the leaked image being of a hybrid XC90, but the closed grille suggests an all-electric powertrain. Look at it from the rear, and an uncanny resemblance to the 
Polestar 2
 can be seen as well.
RELATED: 
Volvo XC40 Recharge Pure Electric sold out for MY2022 in Malaysia – over 400 orders, 120 delivered
Set to be the first of its kind, the Volvo EXC90 will pioneer a new model name for the Swedish brand. 
InsideEVs
 reports that the EXC90 will initially be sold alongside the petrol-powered XC90, which is also expected to receive a facelift. However, in the long run, the EXC90 will likely cannibalize its combustion engine equivalent.
RELATED: 
Polestar 2 debuts in ASEAN with Singapore launch, cheaper than XC40
Volvo unveiled the 
Volvo Concept Recharge
 in June 2021, which was essentially a full-sized electric SUV. The concept revealed Volvo’s new design language that incorporates EV-specific features, and also featured a LiDAR placed on top of the windshield to collect data on the environment around the car.
The Recharge Concept also featured a 15-inch touchscreen infotainment unit, increased interior space, repositioned seats for better seating position, optimised roof profile, and lower bonnet which improves aerodynamic efficiency.
RELATED: 
Here’s how the new 2022 XC90 might look like, thanks to the Volvo Concept Recharge
As such, certain features from the Volvo Recharge Concept are expected to make their way to the upcoming all-electric version of the Volvo XC90. Volvo has committed to making 50% of Volvo Cars’ sales volume to be fully electric and
 putting one million electrified cars on the road by 2025
.
reference_summary: Imej paten Volvo EXC90 serba elektrik akan datang telah dibocorkan di forum peminat kereta Eropah, Worldscoop. Imej yang bocor itu berkongsi isyarat reka bentuk dengan Polestar 2 berasaskan XC40, yang menampilkan gril tertutup yang mencadangkan rangkaian kuasa elektrik semua. EXC90 akan menjadi SUV elektrik pertama Volvo dan bersedia untuk dijual bersama XC90 berkuasa petrol. Volvo Concept Recharge, yang dilancarkan pada Jun 2021, memberikan gambaran tentang reka bentuk EXC90, yang menampilkan LiDAR pada cermin depan, ruang dalaman yang lebih besar dan unit infotainmen skrin sentuh yang diubah kedudukannya. Volvo telah komited untuk menjadikan 50% daripada volum jualannya elektrik dan meletakkan satu juta kereta elektrik di jalan raya menjelang 2025.
